newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hopewell up on China participation talks.
newsitem.headline: Hopewell up on China participation talks.

text.p: Shares of Hopewell Holdings Ltd rose on Thursday on market talk the company might be the next target of interest from a Chinese firm, brokers said.
"Rumours that the China Everbright Group may plan to take a stake in Hopewell boosted the price," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.
Hopewell shares were up HK$0.425 at HK$4.70 in mid-afternoon on volume of 119.47 million shares worth HK$549.54 million.
Hopewell and China Everbright group officials were not immediately available for comment.
Analysts said rotational buying in blue-chip laggards also supported Hopewell's share price.
